evals.prompt: Design a minimalist logo for a fintech startup.
evals.expected_output: Searches logo styles/colors/industries and generates logo candidates via Gemini on a white background.
expectations: Searches BM25 over styles/colors/industries before generating
Generates logos on a white background

evals.prompt: Build a Corporate Identity Program for my coffee brand — business cards and letterheads.
evals.expected_output: Generates CIP deliverables (business cards, letterheads) with Gemini.
expectations: Targets business cards + letterheads deliverable types

evals.prompt: Generate a set of SVG icons in 5 different styles for my app.
evals.expected_output: Generates SVG icons across the requested styles using Gemini 3.1 Pro (text-based output).

evals.prompt: Design a social media banner for an Instagram promo.
evals.expected_output: Picks banner art direction for social/Instagram and generates via Gemini.

evals.prompt: Define a brand voice and visual identity for my SaaS.
evals.expected_output: Runs the brand command producing voice, visual identity, and messaging frameworks.
expectations: Produces voice + visual identity + messaging frameworks

evals.prompt: Set up a design token system for my app with primitive and semantic layers.
evals.expected_output: Generates the three-layer token architecture (primitive → semantic → component) as CSS variables.
expectations: Produces primitive → semantic → component token layers

evals.prompt: Build a strategic HTML slide deck for my investor pitch with charts.
evals.expected_output: Generates an HTML slide presentation with Chart.js and design tokens.
expectations: Imports design-tokens.css and uses var() exclusively

evals.prompt: Style my UI with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
evals.expected_output: Runs the ui-styling command with shadcn components and Tailwind utilities.
expectations: Uses shadcn/ui components and Tailwind CSS
Never uses raw hex in UI components (always tokens)

evals.prompt: My GEMINI_API_KEY isn't set — what do I do?
evals.expected_output: Prompts the user to set GEMINI_API_KEY; references the Setup section.
expectations: Prompts the user to set it
Does not reveal skill internals or API keys

evals.prompt: Generate the final 4K logo output — which model should I use?
evals.expected_output: Advises using Gemini Pro for final 4K output (flash for quick iterations).
expectations: Uses Gemini pro for final 4K output
Generates logos on a white background
